pairs.old: A package is graded by any two seats that did not build it; W4 may grade, and W3 is not required on every grade. A seat never grades its own build. A free seat claims an item before starting by posting "grading <package>" on the Wall, and the second grader claims it the same way; an item already claimed by two seats is not taken a third time. When claims cross, the two earliest posts hold the item and each later seat takes the next one.
pairs.new: A package is graded by one seat that did not build it (operator, 02:05 CST 11-23: "update the manual to just 1 grader."); W4 may grade, and W3 is not required on every grade. A seat never grades its own build. A free seat claims an item before starting by posting "grading <package>" on the Wall; an item already claimed is not taken a second time. When claims cross, the earliest post holds the item and each later seat takes the next one.
